verdict.rationale: Veo is a video generation model, so output aspect ratio and resolution is an applicable axis. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or any resolution or aspect-ratio controls. The vague 'operational formatting rules' and 'cinematic parameter notation' line does not establish this capability.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can render the aspect ratios and resolutions my channels need (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 1080p or above) without external re-encoding
